title: Draft deployment kind protocol v1alpha1: kind manifest
description: What a kind declares it can do. The platform checks a release plan against these declarations before the release is created.

role.description: deployment (the default): the kind deploys components to targets. verification: the kind runs verifications (a test suite, an external tool) and never changes a target.

operations.description: Every operation the kind implements, with its timeout. A deployment kind requires validate, plan, apply and observe; a verification kind requires validate and verify and has no others. A watch's timeout is how long one watch runs before the pool starts the next.

rollback.description: native: the kind implements the rollback operation. redeploy: the engine plans and applies the previous observed version. none: there is no rollback.

mode.description: native: the engine drives each step through this kind's operations. delegated: a tool the customer already runs times the steps, and the kind starts, observes, promotes and aborts it.

tool.description: The tool a delegated strategy hands timing to, for example Argo Rollouts.

default_strategy.description: The kind's own update, used when no rollout policy names a strategy. Must be one of strategies.

target_settings_schema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) object for this kind's target settings.

connectors.description: Connector types whose credentials the pool may release to this kind. Apply and observe credentials are separate; observe is read-only. named lists the connector types a target may bind beside them under an alias of its choosing, one per alias (a Terraform module's long-tail providers, the metrics sources a check reads); absent or empty means the kind takes no named connectors.

observation.description: How often the pool observes a target of this kind, and when an observation is too old to trust (IMPL-279, IMPL-281). A kind that declares watch streams observations instead of being polled, and is polled at the active interval only while no watch runs. Absent members take the platform's defaults: every 15 seconds while an execution is in flight, every 300 at rest, drift every 3600 when the kind has drift, and stale after 1200.

active.description: While an execution is in flight on the target.

stale_after_seconds.description: A target not observed for this long becomes Needs attention, and no gate passes on its observation. It must be longer than the rest interval.
